advisory: Synopsis: ENSO-neutral conditions are present and are favored through April-June 2026 (80% chance). In May-July 2026, El Niño is likely to emerge (61% chance) and persist through at least the end of 2026.
forecast_summary: ENSO-neutral conditions are currently present with the Niño-3.4 index at -0.2°C. Models suggest a possibility of El Niño conditions developing later in the year. The probability chart below shows the seasonal forecast for La Niña (blue), Neutral (grey), and El Niño (red) conditions through the end of the year.
